definitions.explanation: Describes weather that is both hot and uncomfortably humid.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{夏|なつ}は{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い。
examples.english: Summers in Japan are hot and humid.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}くて{眠|ねむ}れない。
examples.english: It's so muggy I can't sleep.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{特|とく}に{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い。
examples.english: It's especially humid during the rainy season.

notes:
Compound adjective: {蒸|む}す (to steam) + {暑|あつ}い (hot)

RELATED WEATHER TERMS:
・{暑|あつ}い (hot)
・{湿度|しつど}が{高|たか}い (high humidity)
・{じめじめする (damp, humid - onomatopoeia)
・{梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season)

CONJUGATION:
・{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}くない (not humid)
・{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}かった (was humid)
・{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}くて (humid, and...)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's summer, especially during {梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season from June to July), is known for being {蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い. This is why air conditioning and fans are essential.
